newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 11.50 trln rbls of bills Jan 8.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 11.50 trln rbls of bills Jan 8.

text.p: The Russian Finance Ministry will auction 4.00 trillion roubles of 154-day GKO discount Treasury bills and 7.50 trillion roubles of 266-day bills on January 8, the Central Bank said on Sunday in a statement.
Sunday was a working day after a four-day New Year holiday.
The series 22053 bills maturing June 4 closed on Sunday with a yield to maturity of 34.92 percent. The 22060 bills maturing September 17 closed on Sunday with a yield of 33.14.

On January 8 the Finance Ministry will also repay about 6.70 trillion roubles of maturing six-month bills (series 22038), and pay around 629 billion roubles in quarterly interest on the 18-month OFZ interest-bearing government bond (series 24005) maturing July 9, 1997.
